title: IpfsBlockStore async_trait enables injection of MemIpfsStore and FailingIpfsStore
description: reader/post/ipfs_write.rs: async_trait on IpfsBlockStore lets tests inject MemIpfsStore (happy path) and FailingIpfsStore (fault injection) without a live IPFS node. Production uses RustIpfsStore. The three-impl pattern is the right way to test IPFS-dependent logic. Do not collapse to a single impl.
